source-integrity.provenance: issuer Q2 release plus independent current market snapshot
source-integrity.duplicateOriginCollapse: Scout/Beta issuer URLs collapse to issuer:NOW:2026Q2:20260722
source-integrity.sourceIndependence: operating claims issuer-derived; current valuation independently sourced

company-underwriting.thesis: ServiceNow combines strong subscription/cRPO growth, broad workflow adoption and a credible AI-governance/orchestration role, but current valuation still embeds substantial durable-growth expectations and AI unit economics remain incompletely isolated.
company-underwriting.keyRisk: Hyperscalers, application suites or model vendors can compress orchestration value while AI deployment growth fails to translate into durable incremental margins.
company-underwriting.nextCatalyst: Next quarterly earnings and cRPO/subscription guidance, with particular attention to normalized federal timing and AI monetization economics.

thesisQuality.basis: AI ACV exceeded $1B, agentic deployments rose ninefold and platform workflows exceed 100B annually, supporting durable adoption while AI economics remain partly unisolated.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Q2 subscription revenue grew 24.5%, cRPO 21%, results beat guidance and full-year subscription outlook was raised.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: At $135.62 on Sep 25 the market capitalization was about $140.23B; strong growth is offset by a still demanding absolute valuation and limited demonstrated downside asymmetry.

catalystScore.basis: Raised guidance and continued cRPO/AI adoption provide credible medium-term catalysts, but incremental AI economics and federal timing normalization remain uncertain.

governancePower.basis: Current evidence demonstrates execution against and above operating guidance but does not independently establish exceptional long-duration capital-allocation or incentive alignment; score is constrained to mixed/adequate band.

alignment2036.basis: Enterprise workflow automation, governance and cross-system AI orchestration address durable needs for reliable governed digital operations.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: IT, security/risk, CRM and employee workflows reuse common platform context and action infrastructure across multiple demand engines.

bottleneckControl.basis: Embedded workflows, CMDB/context and governance create switching friction and coordination value, though hyperscalers and application suites remain credible substitutes.

scenarioRobustness.basis: A model-agnostic workflow/control layer can remain useful across changing AI models, balanced by competitive and technology-platform concentration risk.

substitutionResilience.basis: Deep workflow integration and platform context create replacement barriers, but hyperscalers, model vendors and application suites can expand orchestration capabilities.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Software delivery avoids many physical single-source constraints, but cloud, model and infrastructure dependencies are not sufficiently detailed to support a stronger resilience band.

pricingPower.basis: Sustained subscription growth, expanding cRPO and large installed workflow footprint support value capture, while current evidence does not isolate price versus volume/mix.

riskEvidence.basis: Primary risks are AI unit-economics uncertainty, federal timing acceleration and credible orchestration competition; these are material but do not negate current growth evidence.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Identity/tradability and operating results are primary-source backed and current valuation has an independent snapshot; confidence is reduced because most operating claims share one issuer origin and governance/AI unit economics are not independently corroborated.
